### 🖱️ Smoother aim
- Turning is now even frame to frame on mice that report slower than your display refreshes. Many office and budget mice poll at 125 Hz, which on a 60 Hz screen made one frame in twelve turn noticeably further than its neighbours — a steady hand still looked like it was stuttering, even at a locked 60 FPS.
- The correction costs one mouse period of latency and switches itself off entirely for a 500/1000 Hz mouse, which has nothing to fix.
- It matters most on fast machines, not least: at 165 FPS a 125 Hz mouse leaves some frames with no input at all, so the view used to stop dead for a frame and then jump.

### 🎨 Colour profile
- The graded overcast look is now used in the survival world only. Arenas, menu previews and the editor render ungraded by default, instead of wearing survival's desaturation and vignette.
- The colour profile setting gains an **Automatic (by mode)** option, which is the new default. Picking a profile by hand still applies everywhere.
